notes.text: Plugins can offer a newer version for newer admins while older sites keep the version they can run
New versions of 16 plugins, including Store 1.3.0, Payments 1.1.0 and Markets 1.3.0
The admin builds and passes its checks with any plugin left out
The Store, Payments and the Storefront are plugins you can get from Plugins, like the others
Sales reports, Home’s sales figures and the shop’s policy texts come from the Store plugin
Older Conversions, Bookings and Forms plugins keep their webhook events, secrets and purchase reports
Settings has one link for Updates & developers and one for Brand & marketing; their screens are tabs
Abandoned checkouts is a tab of Orders
An order’s timeline shows its receipt and the shop’s order notice
A site without Conversions no longer sends purchases to ad platforms
Plugins page: the page numbers no longer touch Get more plugins
Every order has its own page: items, payment, customer, shipping address, where they came from, staff notes and a timeline
Test orders are clearly marked, so you can tell them from real sales
Your site’s settings are always used on its pages, even ones made while it was building
A plugin that fails to start is retried once a minute instead of on every visit
Local currency is now part of Markets: each market either shows local prices automatically or uses prices you set for that country
Everyone else is a market too, for visitors from countries you haven’t set up
Settings saved while the site is building now always reach your database
Plugins you get are checked against Pengroove’s signature before your site uses them
Bookings, Automations and other plugins work correctly when the plugins they rely on are removed
Plugins can be added to your site from the Plugins page, so your admin only carries what you use
Chat, Newsletter, Reviews, Promo codes, Membership, Paid access, Shipping, Cookie consent and Imported pages are now separate plugins
Switching a plugin off can no longer change another plugin’s settings
Checkout and newsletter automations wait until Automations is switched on
Connect your AI assistant (Claude, ChatGPT) to your admin out of the box, with a key you create
Pages can be for signed-in members only
Email keys now live in Settings → Email
Switched-off Conversions and Automations now send nothing at all
Missing files are answered from the fast cache instead of the server
Your site's pages and imported pages are listed together under Pages, not as separate menu links
Updates shows your version, a Check for updates button, what's new and how to update
The Plugins page has search, filters, pages and a details page for every plugin, with its version and what's new
See plugins you don't have yet, and newer versions of the ones you do
Bring in a template you bought or a site you built elsewhere, with step-by-step help
Links to pages ending in .html work, add-to-cart buttons work without code, and plain HTML forms send their answers
/cart opens checkout
Checkout only accepts whole-number quantities
Draft and archived products can't be bought
Saving the Home page in one tab no longer undoes changes made in another

plugins.name: Blog
plugins.description: Write posts and publish them on your site at /blog

notes.text: Shipping: charge for delivery and collect the buyer's address at checkout
Products in colours and sizes, with swatches and a photo for each option
Choose which page is your home page
The Plugins page shows each plugin as a card
Forms on your own pages send their answers to Form submissions
Import members from a spreadsheet
Updates: see when a newer version is out and what it brings
Pages load faster and use less server time
Images are converted once, not every time they're shown
Imported pages are served from the fast cache again
Pages can show images from Unsplash

update.message: To update, open your site's repository on GitHub and press Sync fork, or contact us and we'll update it for you.
